name: PACT External npm Test v1

version_rules.datadog_malicious_intent: unpinned; evaluated against the registry latest at run time (all versions are malicious)
version_rules.datadog_compromised_version: one listed compromised version, chosen with the seeded PRNG
version_rules.benign: exact latest version at snapshot time

exclusions.benign: DataDog manifest names; packages with an OSV MAL- advisory for the pinned version at snapshot time

rule: Do not evaluate, inspect results, or tune against this set until all development steps are final.
